overview.description: The Invesco Nasdaq Biotechnology ETF (IBBQ) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the NASDAQ / Biotechnology index, a modified market-cap-weighted index of US biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies listed on the NASDAQ. IBBQ was launched on Jun 11, 2021 and is issued by Invesco.

holdings.infoBox: IBBQ is an equity ETF with a total of 255 individual holdings. The top holdings are Gilead Sciences stock at 8.18%, Vertex Pharmaceuticals at 7.68%, Amgen at 7.56%, Regeneron Pharmaceuticals at 5.27%, and Moderna at 5.09%.
